pages.quiz:
BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

3. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.

4. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

5. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

6. When learning Roof Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Roof Construction.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Roof Construction.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Roof Construction.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Roof Construction.

7. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. International Cricket Team
   D. Information and Communication Technology

8. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

12. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Doors.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Doors and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Windows and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Water Supply and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Sanitary Appliances and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

5. C — CPU

7. D — Information and Communication Technology

9. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

11. A — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Doors; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
